notes:
A third voice to narrate with: Kokoro. Settings › Voice now offers BEST, KOKORO and LIGHTER.

Kokoro carries 11 voices in a single 98 MB download, and its voices are held in a form that can be blended together — something neither of the others can do. The trade is honest and worth knowing before you pick it: it is roughly 5x slower to generate than BEST, so it cannot keep up with live reading. Prepare a chapter first and it plays back instantly. Installing it takes several minutes.

BEST stays the default and is still the right choice for reading as you go — it generates faster than it plays, at a higher sample rate.

Character casting stays on BEST for now. Casting picks voices by pitch, and BEST's voices have been measured while Kokoro's have not; casting on numbers nobody has checked would be a guess dressed up as a measurement.

Also fixed: the LIGHTER engine's voice downloads. They finished downloading and then unpacked nothing at all — a fault that had been there since that engine was written.
